sites.name: Petit Planet Companion
sites.subject: For Petit Planet, the life sim from HoYoverse that launches on 4 December 2026 for PC, iOS and Android.
sites.inside: All 17 known neighbors and what they like, a gift finder, a birthday calendar you can subscribe to, launch codes and a checklist for launch day.
sites.status: Built on data from the final beta, which gets checked against the released game in launch week.

sites.name: Aurora Go/No-Go
sites.subject: For anyone in Australia or New Zealand deciding whether the southern lights are worth going out for tonight.
sites.inside: A plain go, maybe or no for 36 places, worked out from NOAA space weather, the cloud forecast and how dark it gets. You can add a spot of your own.
sites.status: Live readings refresh every five minutes and always show how old they are.

sites.name: Stranger Than Heaven Tracker
sites.subject: For Stranger Than Heaven, the next game from RGG Studio, out on 15 January 2027.
sites.inside: A tick-off tracker for all 59 achievements, act by act, with story spoilers hidden until you ask. Release details, editions, cast and a timeline sit alongside.
sites.status: The achievement list is pre-release and unconfirmed, and gets checked against the released game in launch week.
